Resolution.PluginDescription: Reports the screen resolutions of your visitors.
Resolution.WidgetGlobalVisitorsDocumentation: This report shows the most common overall configurations that your visitors had. A configuration is the combination of an operating system, a browser type and a screen resolution.
Resolution.WidgetResolutionsDocumentation: This report shows the screen resolutions your visitors used when viewing your website.
Resolution.ScreenResolutionDetectionDisabledRequire: Screen resolution detection and screen resolution report must be disabled.
Resolution.ScreenResolutionDetectionComplianceDescr:
Screen resolution detection is disabled.

This reduces the risk of identifying visitors based on their screen configuration.
Resolution.ScreenResolutionDetectionComplianceImpac: Screen resolution information is not collected, and screen resolution reports under Visitors > Devices are unavailable.
Resolution.ScreenResolutionReportDisabledByComplian: Screen resolution report is disabled by compliance policy.
